-- The round-trip gate for the versioned syntax artifacts: read one artifact
-- file, decode it into the typed Syntax vocabulary, re-encode, and print the
-- exact bytes. arg(0) is the artifact path; arg(1) selects the family
-- ("tokens", "surface", "diagnostics", or "resolved"). The "resolved-nodes"
-- mode instead decodes the resolved document and prints the id of every node
-- reached by traversing each function body with `rnode_universe`, one per
-- line: the Prism-side traversal the checker join is diffed against, reading
-- only the artifact bytes. A refusal prints one structured error line.
import Data.Foldable (length)
import Data.List (concat_map)
import Syntax.Codec (..)
import Syntax.Resolved (..)

fn main() =
  let text = read_file(arg(0))
  if arg(1) == "tokens" then
    match decode_tokens(text) of
      Err(e) => println("decode error: {codec_error_message(e)}")
      Ok(d) => println(encode_tokens(d))
  elif arg(1) == "diagnostics" then
    match decode_diagnostics(text) of
      Err(e) => println("decode error: {codec_error_message(e)}")
      Ok(d) => println(encode_diagnostics(d))
  elif arg(1) == "resolved" then
    match decode_resolved(text) of
      Err(e) => println("decode error: {codec_error_message(e)}")
      Ok(d) => println(encode_resolved(d))
  elif arg(1) == "resolved-nodes" then
    match decode_resolved(text) of
      Err(e) => println("decode error: {codec_error_message(e)}")
      Ok(d) => print_resolved_ids(d)
  else
    match decode_surface(text) of
      Err(e) => println("decode error: {codec_error_message(e)}")
      Ok(d) => println(encode_surface(d))

-- Every node id reached by walking each function body with the Prism-side
-- `rnode_universe`, sorted ascending, one per line under a `count` header. A
-- pure function of the decoded document: no source file or compiler state is
-- consulted.
fn print_resolved_ids(d : ResolvedDoc) =
  let ids = sort(
      concat_map(
          \(f) -> map(\(n) -> n.id, rnode_universe(f.body)),
          d.functions,
        ),
    )
  println("count {length(ids)}")
  print_ids(ids)

fn print_ids(ids : List(Int)) : Unit ! {IO} =
  match ids of
    Nil => ()
    Cons(i, rest) =>
      println("{i}")
      print_ids(rest)
